name: autohodl
description: Set up autoHODL scheduled USDC savings on Solana. Works alongside MoonPay CLI (mp mcp) for signing — no additional server required.
instructions: To set up autoHODL savings: (1) Call autohodl_lookup with the user's MoonPay wallet address. If the result is null, tell the user to send `/start <walletAddress>` to @autohodl_bot on Telegram and wait for them to confirm before continuing. The lookup returns { walletAddress, vaultAddress, walletUsdcBalance, vaultUsdcBalance, settings }. The vault is a Squads v4 PDA deterministically derived from the wallet — funds live in the vault; the wallet signs as Squads authority. (2) Confirm the savings frequency (daily/weekly/monthly) and amount in USD with the user. (3) Optional pre-funding: if walletUsdcBalance > 0 and the user wants to seed the vault from existing wallet balance, call MoonPay's token_transfer with wallet='main' (or the wallet name), chain='solana', token='USDC', to=<vaultAddress from step 1>, amount=<amount>. This is OPTIONAL — if the user is going to fund via MoonPay recurring buys, those land in the vault directly and no transfer is needed. (4) Call solana_action_prepare with actionUrl='https://autohodl-solana-autohodl-bzflgqp54-locker-money.vercel.app/api/actions/authorize', account=<walletAddress>, and params={ freq: <frequency>, amount: <usdAmount> }. This returns { txBase64, confirmUrl, message }. The transaction initializes the user's Squads multisig (with the MoonPay wallet as sole member) and registers autoHODL as a constrained spending-limit delegate on the USDC mint. (5) Sign and broadcast via MoonPay: transaction_sign with wallet=<wallet name>, chain='solana', transaction=<txBase64>; then transaction_send with chain='solana', transaction=<signedTx>. (6) If confirmUrl is non-null, call solana_action_confirm with the confirmUrl from step 4 and the signature from step 5. (7) Report to the user: their Squads vault is live, autoHODL has constrained delegate authority, and their savings schedule is active. They retain full ownership of the vault.
